name: lance_encoding::repdef::SerializerContext::normalize_specials_and_plan_splits
behavior: Split planner early exits: no defs, no rep, absent budget, zero visible values, any FSL, or no variable-list meaning. Existing defs are normalized on all exits except already-empty defs. Planner tracks row and page dense ranges and visible counts. A row has overhead iff dense entries exceed visible values. Record over-budget count only for rows with overhead; last offending row overwrites prior count. Greedily split before a row only if current page nonempty, either side has overhead and combined levels exceed budget. Dense-only long rows are exempt from this policy. Normalize each special while scanning equal buffers. Top row starts exactly when rep equals schema list count. Levels before a top-row start, absent starts, or a first discovered start after position0 return Internal. Count visible defs<=threshold and finish final row. Input state can already be normalized when error occurs; serializer is consumed by caller. Counted top rows and visible values must equal supplied counts or Internal includes expected/actual. No overhead returns WithinBudget; any offending row returns SingleRowOverBudget before page-split result. Otherwise append final split and require more than one split for RequiresPageSplit. Does not emit pages or choose fallback codec.
